item.title: Self-Hosted DNS Caching Resolvers: Unbound vs dnscrypt-proxy vs BIND (2026)
item.description: A DNS caching resolver sits between your network and upstream DNS servers, storing query results to reduce latency, improve reliability, and provide a first line of defense against DNS-based threats. Whether you’re running a home lab or managing enterprise infrastructure, choosing the right caching resolver impacts every network operation.
